post.title: Evaluation Service v1.1 Update
post.summary: SOL-ExecBench has updated its evaluation service. New results are shown separately from results produced by the previous service.
post.content:
We have updated the SOL-ExecBench evaluation service. Because this change may affect performance measurements, results produced by the new service (**v1.1**) should not be directly compared with results from the previous service (**v1.0**).

The evaluation version is shown with each result, and kernel and collection leaderboards can be filtered by version. The default view shows v1.1 results; historical v1.0 results remain available.

To make the transition easier, we will re-evaluate the 5 highest-ranked public v1.0 submissions on each leaderboard with the new service. Their new results will appear in the v1.1 view.

Thank you to [doubleAI](https://www.doubleai.com/) for reporting 7 reward hacks that circumvented our defense checks. We have addressed all 7 in the v1.1 update with a much stronger verifier.
